GKV-ONLY line. In UKV, inventory movements are absorbed into Herstellungskosten (COGS only contains expenses for goods actually sold).

pnl_format_bridge.allocation_method: absorbed into COGS via capitalised costs
pnl_format_bridge.notes: GKV-ONLY line. In UKV, self-built assets reduce the period's functional cost lines (typically COGS) via capitalisation entries.
Position exists in both. No reclassification.
ALLOCATION REQUIRED. Production material → COGS. Marketing material/swag → Vertrieb. Office supplies → Verwaltung. Without cost-center data, default everything to COGS as best-effort.
ALLOCATION REQUIRED. Subcontracted production → COGS. Outsourced sales → Vertrieb. Consulting/IT/audit → Verwaltung.
ALLOCATION REQUIRED. Direct labor (production) → COGS. Sales/marketing → Vertrieb. G&A → Verwaltung. The single biggest item that disappears in UKV.
ALLOCATION REQUIRED. Same split-ratio as the underlying salary line.
ALLOCATION REQUIRED. Factory equipment & buildings → COGS. Sales fleet → Vertrieb. HQ building → Verwaltung.
Typically Wertberichtigungen Forderungen — maps to sonstige betriebliche Aufwendungen in UKV.

ALLOCATION REQUIRED. Mieten/Energie production → COGS. Vertriebskosten (Werbung, Reise) → Vertrieb. Büro/IT/Versicherungen → Verwaltung. Residuals (Verluste Anlagenabgang, etc.) → sonstige betr. Aufwendungen.
Bottom-line is identical: total expenses captured the same way, just grouped differently.

pnl_format_detection.rationale: Exact §275 Abs. 3 Nr. 2 wording. Cannot appear in GKV.
§275 Abs. 3 Nr. 2 — name of the COGS line in UKV.
§275 Abs. 3 Nr. 3 — UKV subtotal. Does not exist in GKV.
UKV subtotal. (Caveat: §276 HGB allows small companies to combine Pos. 1-5 GKV into 'Rohergebnis' — different concept.)
§275 Abs. 3 Nr. 4. Function-of-expense category that only exists in UKV.
Often shown as separate line in UKV statements (subset of Verwaltungskosten in §275 strict reading). Not a GKV position.
§275 Abs. 2 Nr. 5. Nature-of-expense category that only appears as a line in GKV.
§275 Abs. 2 Nr. 6. Aggregate label is GKV-only (UKV splits this across functional lines).
If shown as standalone GuV line — GKV. (Caveat: appears as cost-center detail in some UKV statements; treat with care.)
§275 Abs. 2 Nr. 2 — GKV-only. UKV absorbs inventory movement into COGS.
Standalone line typically signals GKV. (See Löhne caveat.)
